title: Noor and the Typewriter
author: Ivo Delacroix
blurb: Odile Voss, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
